headline: Delhivery announces fresh grant of employee stock options
hook: New stock options granted to employees
summary: Delhivery Limited has officially informed the NSE regarding the grant of stock options to its employees. This move is part of the company's ongoing employee incentive and retention program. Such grants typically involve the issuance of new equity shares upon exercise, which can lead to minor equity dilution for existing shareholders. Retail investors should note that these grants are standard corporate practice for talent management.
why_it_matters: Minor equity dilution may impact future earnings per share.
